The '''Riorians'''<ref name="YouTube">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Alien Species in the Original Trilogy|video=yHVzcCGUM9U|nolive=1}}</ref> were an [[Insectoid|insect-like]] [[species]]. One named<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> [[Loje Nella]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> was present during a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]] at [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riorians were originally created for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> The one who appeared in that film was portrayed via a puppet<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> operated by [[Mike Quinn]]<ref name="Quinn">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/mike-quinn-nien-nunb|text=Mike Quinn (Nien Nunb)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|work=[https://starwarsinterviews.com Star Wars Interviews]|quote=I have a vague memory of getting inside that Toadstool thing from under the set, too, at one point.|archivedate=20180124195951|nolive=1}}</ref> and given the production nickname "Toadstool Terror" by the creature creators of the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] Monster Shop.<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" />
